body.claim: Repository paths are parsed, not validated, and cannot escape the root once constructed.
body.detail: Record path members arrive from cloned repositories and are untrusted. The constructor is the only door, and it rejects traversal, absolute paths, drive letters, UNC prefixes, Windows device names and alternate data streams.

body.claim: Every optional member of Anchor must carry skip_serializing_if for its default, or it re-identifies every record written before that member existed.
body.detail: A record id is the hash of its canonical encoding and decode_line recomputes it on read, so a member that serialises at its default changes the id of older records, breaking the hash chain and every supersession link into them. It presents as a corrupt ledger, not as a schema change. context_siblings and symbol_kind did this and orphaned 43 of 44 records here. conformance/records/identity.jsonl is the guard.
